user.title: Rocket R60V
user.description: Enter the machine's control endpoint. Connect directly to the machine's own access point at 192.168.1.1, or, if you run the bundled bridge on a host with a spare Wi-Fi radio, enter the bridge's LAN address instead.

data_description.push_url: If your bridge runs the WebSocket push server, enter its URL (e.g. ws://<bridge-ip>:8788) to receive near-real-time state (local push) instead of polling. Leave blank to poll.
data_description.bridge_health_url: If your bridge runs the companion link watchdog + health endpoint, enter its URL (e.g. http://<bridge-ip>:8787/health) so the integration can pause polling while the bridge recovers the link and surface bridge diagnostics. Leave blank to disable.

init.title: Rocket R60V options
init.description: Configure the optional WebSocket push channel and bridge-health back-channel.

data_description.push_url: URL of the bridge's WebSocket push server (e.g. ws://<bridge-ip>:8788). When set, the integration receives near-real-time state (local push) instead of polling. Leave blank to poll.
data_description.bridge_health_url: URL of the bridge's health endpoint (e.g. http://<bridge-ip>:8787/health). Leave blank to disable the back-channel and its diagnostic sensors.
